Revisando el código del botón de aprobar:


El botón de "Aprobar" actualmente aprueba directamente sin abrir el dialog, usando una razón genérica. Ajustándolo para que abra el dialog con la decisión pre-seleccionada como "APPROVED", permitiendo escribir una razón personalizada:


```typescriptreact
"use client";

import { useTranslation } from "@/app/config/i18n";
import { Card, CardBody, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  UserCheck,
  Clock,
  CheckCircle,
  AlertTriangle,
  Filter,
  Settings,
  TrendingUp,
  AlertCircle,
  Eye,
  X,
  Edit,
  Save
} from "lucide-react";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { mockHitlData, type HitlIntervention, type HitlDecision, type HitlMetrics, type HitlSupervisionConfig } from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockHitl";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { RichTextEditor } from "@/components/ui/rich-text-editor";

export default function HitlSupervisionPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [data, setData] = useState(mockHitlData);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [filterDecisionType, setFilterDecisionType] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [configDialogOpen, setConfigDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedConfig, setSelectedConfig] = useState<HitlSupervisionConfig | null>(null);
  const [decisionDialogOpen, setDecisionDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIntervention, setSelectedIntervention] = useState<HitlIntervention | null>(null);
  const [decisionReason, setDecisionReason] = useState<string>("");
  const [decisionType, setDecisionType] = useState<string>("APPROVED");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/dashboard");
      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.success) {
          setData(result.data);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading HITL data:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredInterventions = data?.pendingInterventions.filter((intervention) => {
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === "ALL" || intervention.status === filterStatus;
    const matchesType = filterType === "ALL" || intervention.entityType === filterType;
    return matchesStatus && matchesType;
  });

  const filteredDecisions = data?.recentDecisions.filter((decision) => {
    const matchesType = filterDecisionType === "ALL" || decision.entityType === filterDecisionType;
    return matchesType;
  });

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "APPROVED":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-green-500">
            <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.approved")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "REJECTED":
        return (
          <Badge variant="destructive">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.rejected")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "MODIFIED":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-blue-500">
            <Edit className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("compliance.hitl.decisions.MODIFIED", "Modificado")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "IN_REVIEW":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-blue-500">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.inReview")}
          </Badge>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-yellow-500">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.pending")}
          </Badge>
        );
    }
  };

  const getUrgencyBadge = (urgency?: string) => {
    switch (urgency) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return <Badge variant="destructive">CRITICAL</Badge>;
      case "HIGH":
        return <Badge className="bg-orange-500">HIGH</Badge>;
      case "MEDIUM":
        return <Badge className="bg-yellow-500">MEDIUM</Badge>;
      default:
        return <Badge variant="outline">LOW</Badge>;
    }
  };

  const handleRecordDecision = async (interventionId: number, decision: string, reason: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/interventions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          interventionId,
          decision,
          reason,
          userId: "current-user",
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        await loadData();
        setDecisionDialogOpen(false);
        setSelectedIntervention(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error recording decision:", error);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateConfig = async (config: HitlSupervisionConfig) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/config", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(config),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        await loadData();
        setConfigDialogOpen(false);
        setSelectedConfig(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error updating config:", error);
    }
  };

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="w-full min-h-full bg-gradient-to-br from-background via-background to-background/80 relative overflow-x-hidden">
      {/* Partículas flotantes */}
      <div className="absolute inset-0 overflow-hidden pointer-events-none">
        <div className="absolute top-1/4 left-1/4 w-2 h-2 bg-cyan-400/30 rounded-full animate-pulse" />
        <div className="absolute top-1/3 right-1/4 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/20 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-300" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 left-1/3 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-cyan-400/25 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-700" />
      </div>

      <div className="relative z-10 w-full space-y-6">
        {/* Header - HITL Supervision Dashboard */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-center space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-3 mb-4">
              <UserCheck className="w-8 h-8 text-cyan-500" />
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-500 to-cyan-700 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
                {t("governance.hitlSupervision.title")}
              </h1>
            </div>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">
              {t("governance.hitlSupervision.subtitle")}
            </p>
          </div>
          <Dialog open={configDialogOpen} onOpenChange={setConfigDialogOpen}>
            <DialogTrigger asChild>
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfigDialogOpen(true)}>
                <Settings className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.configure", "Configurar")}
              </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
              <DialogHeader>
                <DialogTitle>{t("compliance.hitl.configuration", "Configuración de Supervisión")}</DialogTitle>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="btn-close"
                  onClick={() => setConfigDialogOpen(false)}
                  aria-label="Close"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', fontSize: '1.5rem', opacity: 0.5 }}
                ></button>
              </DialogHeader>
              <div className="modal-body" style={{ maxHeight: '70vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {data.supervisionConfig.map((config) => (
                    <Card key={config.type}>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg">
                          {t(`compliance.hitl.supervisionTypes.${config.type}`, config.type)}
                        </CardTitle>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.enabled", "Habilitado")}</Label>
                          <Switch
                            checked={config.enabled}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                              const updated = { ...config, enabled: checked };
                              handleUpdateConfig(updated);
                            }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.slaHours", "SLA (horas)")}</Label>
                          <Input
                            type="number"
                            value={config.slaHours}
                            onChange={(e) => {
                              const updated = { ...config, slaHours: parseInt(e.target.value) };
                              handleUpdateConfig(updated);
                            }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.autoEscalation", "Escalación Automática")}</Label>
                          <Switch
                            checked={config.autoEscalation}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                              const updated = { ...config, autoEscalation: checked };
                              handleUpdateConfig(updated);
                            }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </CardContent>
                    </Card>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="modal-footer" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--theme-border)', padding: '1rem' }}>
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setConfigDialogOpen(false)}>
                  {t("common.close", "Cerrar")}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </DialogContent>
          </Dialog>
        </div>

        {/* Métricas Principales - SOLO 3 CARDS */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
          {/* Card 1: Tiempo promedio de respuesta */}
          <Card className="group hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg">
            <CardBody>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <Clock className="h-5 w-5 text-cyan-500" />
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.averageResponseTime")}</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{data.metrics.averageResponseTime.toFixed(1)}h</div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Card 2: Tasa de aprobación */}
          <Card className="group hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg">
            <CardBody>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <CheckCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-green-500" />
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.approvalRate")}</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold">
                {(data.metrics.approvalRate * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
          {/* Card 3: Tasa de cumplimiento SLA */}
          <Card className="group hover:scale-[1.02] transition-all duration-300 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg">
            <CardBody>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
                <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-green-500" />
                <TrendingUp className="h-4 w-4 text-green-500" />
              </div>
              <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.slaComplianceRate")}</div>
              <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-600">
                {(data.metrics.slaCompliance * 100).toFixed(0)}%
              </div>
            </CardBody>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs para Intervenciones y Decisiones */}
        <Tabs defaultValue="interventions" className="space-y-4">
          <TabsList>
            <TabsTrigger value="interventions">
              {t("compliance.hitl.pendingInterventions", "Intervenciones Pendientes")} ({data.metrics.pendingInterventions})
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="decisions">
              {t("compliance.hitl.recentDecisions", "Decisiones Recientes")} ({data.recentDecisions.length})
            </TabsTrigger>
          </TabsList>

          <TabsContent value="interventions" className="space-y-4">
            <Card className="group hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-700 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg">
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <CardTitle>{t("compliance.hitl.pendingInterventions", "Intervenciones Pendientes")}</CardTitle>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Filter className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <Select value={filterStatus} onValueChange={setFilterStatus}>
                      <SelectTrigger className="w-[150px]">
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value="ALL">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.allStatus")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="PENDING">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.pending")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="IN_REVIEW">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.inReview")}</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                    <Select value={filterType} onValueChange={setFilterType}>
                      <SelectTrigger className="w-[150px]">
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value="ALL">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.allTypes")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Agent">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.agent")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Model">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.model")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Prompt">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.prompt")}</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                {filteredInterventions?.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("compliance.hitl.noPendingInterventions", "No hay intervenciones pendientes")}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    {filteredInterventions?.map((intervention) => {
                      const isSlaUrgent = intervention.timeRemaining < 1;
                      const isSlaWarning = intervention.timeRemaining < 2 && intervention.timeRemaining >= 1;

                      return (
                        <Card
                          key={intervention.id}
                          className="transition-all hover:shadow-lg"
                          style={{
                            backgroundColor: isSlaUrgent
                              ? "var(--theme-error)"
                              : isSlaWarning
                              ? "var(--theme-warning)"
                              : "var(--theme-card)",
                            borderColor: isSlaUrgent
                              ? "var(--theme-error)"
                              : isSlaWarning
                              ? "var(--theme-warning)"
                              : "var(--theme-border)",
                          }}
                        >
                          <CardContent className="p-4">
                            <div className="flex items-start gap-4">
                              {/* Contenido principal */}
                              <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 flex-wrap">
                                  <Badge variant="outline">{intervention.entityType}</Badge>
                                  <span className="font-semibold text-sm">{intervention.entityName}</span>
                                </div>
                                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3 flex-wrap">
                                  {getStatusBadge(intervention.status)}
                                  {getUrgencyBadge(intervention.urgency)}
                                  {isSlaUrgent && (
                                    <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                                      <AlertCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                                      SLA Urgente
                                    </Badge>
                                  )}
                                  {isSlaWarning && (
                                    <Badge className="bg-orange-500 text-xs">
                                      <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
                                      SLA Próximo
                                    </Badge>
                                  )}
                                </div>
                                <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
                                  <div>
                                    <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.type", "Tipo")}:</strong> {intervention.type}
                                  </div>
                                  <div>
                                    <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.createdAt", "Creado")}:</strong>{" "}
                                    {new Date(intervention.createdAt).toLocaleString()}
                                  </div>
                                  <div>
                                    <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.slaDeadline", "SLA Deadline")}:</strong>{" "}
                                    {new Date(intervention.slaDeadline).toLocaleString()}
                                  </div>
                                  <div>
                                    <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.timeRemaining", "Tiempo Restante")}:</strong>{" "}
                                    <span className={isSlaUrgent ? "text-red-600 font-bold" : isSlaWarning ? "text-orange-600 font-semibold" : ""}>
                                      {intervention.timeRemaining.toFixed(1)}h
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              </div>

                              {/* Botones de acción en el lateral derecho */}
                              {intervention.status === "PENDING" && (
                                <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 min-w-[120px]">
                                  <Button
                                    size="sm"
                                    variant="outline"
                                    className="w-full"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setSelectedIntervention(intervention);
                                      setDecisionDialogOpen(true);
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                                    {t("common.review", "Revisar")}
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    size="sm"
                                    className="w-full"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setSelectedIntervention(intervention);
                                      setDecisionType("APPROVED");
                                      setDecisionReason("");
                                      setDecisionDialogOpen(true);
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                                    {t("common.approve", "Aprobar")}
                                  </Button>
                                  <Button
                                    size="sm"
                                    variant="destructive"
                                    className="w-full"
                                    onClick={() => {
                                      setSelectedIntervention(intervention);
                                      setDecisionDialogOpen(true);
                                    }}
                                  >
                                    <X className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                                    {t("common.reject", "Rechazar")}
                                  </Button>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </CardContent>
                        </Card>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>

          <TabsContent value="decisions" className="space-y-4">
            <Card className="group hover:scale-[1.01] transition-all duration-700 bg-card/80 backdrop-blur-sm border-border shadow-lg">
              <CardHeader>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <CardTitle>{t("compliance.hitl.recentDecisions", "Decisiones Recientes")}</CardTitle>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Filter className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                    <Select value={filterDecisionType} onValueChange={setFilterDecisionType}>
                      <SelectTrigger className="w-[150px]">
                        <SelectValue />
                      </SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectContent>
                        <SelectItem value="ALL">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.allTypes")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Agent">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.agent")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Model">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.model")}</SelectItem>
                        <SelectItem value="Prompt">{t("governance.hitlSupervision.prompt")}</SelectItem>
                      </SelectContent>
                    </Select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent>
                {filteredDecisions?.length === 0 ? (
                  <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                    {t("compliance.hitl.noRecentDecisions", "No hay decisiones recientes")}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                    {filteredDecisions?.map((decision) => (
                      <Card
                        key={decision.id}
                        className="transition-all hover:shadow-lg bg-card"
                      >
                        <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2 flex-wrap">
                            <Badge variant="outline">{decision.entityType}</Badge>
                            <span className="font-semibold text-sm">{decision.entityName}</span>
                          </div>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-3">
                            {getStatusBadge(decision.decision)}
                          </div>
                          <div className="text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
                            <div>
                              <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.decisionReason", "Razón")}:</strong>{" "}
                              <span className="text-foreground">{decision.decisionReason}</span>
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.responseTime", "Tiempo de Respuesta")}:</strong>{" "}
                              {decision.responseTime.toFixed(1)}h
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.decisionDate", "Fecha")}:</strong>{" "}
                              {new Date(decision.decisionDate).toLocaleString()}
                            </div>
                            <div>
                              <strong>{t("compliance.hitl.userId", "Usuario")}:</strong>{" "}
                              <span className="text-foreground">{decision.userId}</span>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        </CardContent>
                      </Card>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </TabsContent>
        </Tabs>
      </div>

      {/* Dialog para registrar decisión */}
      <Dialog open={decisionDialogOpen} onOpenChange={(open) => {
        setDecisionDialogOpen(open);
        if (!open) {
          setDecisionReason("");
          setDecisionType("APPROVED");
        }
      }}>
        <DialogContent maxWidth="700px">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{t("compliance.hitl.recordDecision", "Registrar Decisión")}</DialogTitle>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="btn-close"
              onClick={() => setDecisionDialogOpen(false)}
              aria-label="Close"
              style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', fontSize: '1.5rem', opacity: 0.5 }}
            ></button>
          </DialogHeader>
          {selectedIntervention && (
            <div className="modal-body" style={{ minHeight: '550px', maxHeight: '80vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <div>
                  <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.entity", "Entidad")}</Label>
                  <Input value={selectedIntervention.entityName} readOnly />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.decision", "Decisión")}</Label>
                  <Select value={decisionType} onValueChange={setDecisionType}>
                    <SelectTrigger>
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent>
                      <SelectItem value="APPROVED">{t("compliance.hitl.decisions.APPROVED", "Aprobado")}</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="REJECTED">{t("compliance.hitl.decisions.REJECTED", "Rechazado")}</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="MODIFIED">{t("compliance.hitl.decisions.MODIFIED", "Modificado")}</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label className="mb-2 block">{t("compliance.hitl.decisionReason", "Razón de la Decisión")}</Label>
                  <RichTextEditor
                    value={decisionReason}
                    onChange={setDecisionReason}
                    placeholder={t("compliance.hitl.decisionReasonPlaceholder", "Explica la razón de la decisión...")}
                    minHeight="350px"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          <div className="modal-footer" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--theme-border)', padding: '1rem' }}>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
                setDecisionDialogOpen(false);
                setDecisionReason("");
                setDecisionType("APPROVED");
              }}>
                {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={() => {
                handleRecordDecision(selectedIntervention!.id, decisionType, decisionReason);
                setDecisionReason("");
                setDecisionType("APPROVED");
              }}>
                <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}

```

Actualizado el botón de "Aprobar". Ahora:

1. Abre el dialog de registrar decisión
2. Pre-selecciona "APPROVED" en el campo de decisión
3. Permite escribir la razón usando el editor de texto enriquecido
4. Al guardar, envía la decisión con la razón personalizada

Antes aprobaba directamente con una razón genérica ("Approved by supervisor") sin abrir el dialog. Ahora el flujo es:

- **Revisar**: Abre el dialog sin pre-seleccionar decisión
- **Aprobar**: Abre el dialog con "APPROVED" pre-seleccionado
- **Rechazar**: Abre el dialog (debería pre-seleccionar "REJECTED")

¿Quieres que el botón "Rechazar" también pre-seleccione "REJECTED" en el dialog?

---

**User**

si

**Cursor**

```typescriptreact
"use client";

  X,

import { mockHitlData, type HitlIntervention, type HitlDecision, type HitlMetrics, type HitlSupervisionConfig } from "@/app/(app)/governance/data/mockHitl";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";

import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";
import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogHeader, DialogTitle, DialogTrigger } from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import { RichTextEditor } from "@/components/ui/rich-text-editor";

export default function HitlSupervisionPage() {
  const { t } = useTranslation();
  const [data, setData] = useState(mockHitlData);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [filterDecisionType, setFilterDecisionType] = useState<string>("ALL");
  const [configDialogOpen, setConfigDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedConfig, setSelectedConfig] = useState<HitlSupervisionConfig | null>(null);
  const [decisionDialogOpen, setDecisionDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIntervention, setSelectedIntervention] = useState<HitlIntervention | null>(null);
  const [decisionReason, setDecisionReason] = useState<string>("");
  const [decisionType, setDecisionType] = useState<string>("APPROVED");

  useEffect(() => {
    loadData();
  }, []);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      setLoading(true);
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/dashboard");
      if (response.ok) {
        const result = await response.json();
        if (result.success) {
          setData(result.data);
        }
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error loading HITL data:", error);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const filteredInterventions = data?.pendingInterventions.filter((intervention) => {
    const matchesStatus = filterStatus === "ALL" || intervention.status === filterStatus;
    const matchesType = filterType === "ALL" || intervention.entityType === filterType;
    return matchesStatus && matchesType;
  });

  const filteredDecisions = data?.recentDecisions.filter((decision) => {
    const matchesType = filterDecisionType === "ALL" || decision.entityType === filterDecisionType;
    return matchesType;
  });

  const getStatusBadge = (status: string) => {
    switch (status) {
      case "APPROVED":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-green-500">
            <CheckCircle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.approved")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "REJECTED":
        return (
          <Badge variant="destructive">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.rejected")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "MODIFIED":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-blue-500">
            <Edit className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("compliance.hitl.decisions.MODIFIED", "Modificado")}
          </Badge>
        );
      case "IN_REVIEW":
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-blue-500">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.inReview")}
          </Badge>
        );
      default:
        return (
          <Badge className="bg-yellow-500">
            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 mr-1" />
            {t("governance.hitlSupervision.pending")}
          </Badge>
        );
    }
  };

  const getUrgencyBadge = (urgency?: string) => {
    switch (urgency) {
      case "CRITICAL":
        return <Badge variant="destructive">CRITICAL</Badge>;
      case "HIGH":
        return <Badge className="bg-orange-500">HIGH</Badge>;
      case "MEDIUM":
        return <Badge className="bg-yellow-500">MEDIUM</Badge>;
      default:
        return <Badge variant="outline">LOW</Badge>;
    }
  };

  const handleRecordDecision = async (interventionId: number, decision: string, reason: string) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/interventions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify({
          interventionId,
          decision,
          reason,
          userId: "current-user",
        }),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        await loadData();
        setDecisionDialogOpen(false);
        setSelectedIntervention(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error recording decision:", error);
    }
  };

  const handleUpdateConfig = async (config: HitlSupervisionConfig) => {
    try {
      const response = await fetch("/api/compliance/hitl/config", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(config),
      });

      if (response.ok) {
        await loadData();
        setConfigDialogOpen(false);
        setSelectedConfig(null);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Error updating config:", error);
    }
  };

  if (loading && !data) {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-center min-h-screen">
        <div className="animate-spin rounded-full h-12 w-12 border-b-2 border-primary"></div>
      </div>
    );

  return (

        <div className="absolute top-1/3 right-1/4 w-1.5 h-1.5 bg-cyan-400/20 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-300" />
        <div className="absolute bottom-1/4 left-1/3 w-2.5 h-2.5 bg-cyan-400/25 rounded-full animate-pulse delay-700" />

            </div>
            <p className="text-muted-foreground">
              {t("governance.hitlSupervision.subtitle")}

                {t("common.configure", "Configurar")}
              </Button>
            </DialogTrigger>
            <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">

                <DialogTitle>{t("compliance.hitl.configuration", "Configuración de Supervisión")}</DialogTitle>

                  aria-label="Close"
                  style={{ backgroundColor: 'transparent', border: 'none', fontSize: '1.5rem', opacity: 0.5 }}
                ></button>
              </DialogHeader>
              <div className="modal-body" style={{ maxHeight: '70vh', overflowY: 'auto' }}>
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  {data.supervisionConfig.map((config) => (
                    <Card key={config.type}>
                      <CardHeader>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg">
                          {t(`compliance.hitl.supervisionTypes.${config.type}`, config.type)}
                        </CardTitle>
                      </CardHeader>
                      <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                          <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.enabled", "Habilitado")}</Label>
                          <Switch
                            checked={config.enabled}
                            onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                              const updated = { ...config, enabled: checked };
                              handleUpdateConfig(updated);
                            }}
                          />
                        </div>
                        <div>
                          <Label>{t("compliance.hitl.slaHours", "SLA (horas)")}</Label>
                          <Input

          <div className="modal-footer" style={{ borderTop: '1px solid var(--theme-border)', padding: '1rem' }}>
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => {
                setDecisionDialogOpen(false);
                setDecisionReason("");
                setDecisionType("APPROVED");
              }}>
                {t("common.cancel", "Cancelar")}
              </Button>
              <Button onClick={() => {
                handleRecordDecision(selectedIntervention!.id, decisionType, decisionReason);
                setDecisionReason("");
                setDecisionType("APPROVED");
              }}>
                <Save className="h-4 w-4 mr-2" />
                {t("common.save", "Guardar")}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>
    </div>
  );
}
```

- **Rechazar**: Abre el dialog con "REJECTED" pre-seleccionado

```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

    public List<HitlInterventionData> getPendingInterventions(String type, String entityType, Boolean slaExceeded) {
        log.info("Retrieving pending HITL interventions: type={}, entityType={}, slaExceeded={}",
            type, entityType, slaExceeded);
        try {

                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            return interventions;
        } catch (Exception e) {

            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving pending HITL interventions", e);

    /**
     * Obtiene historial de decisiones
     * Retorna clases de datos internas (NO DTOs) - la conversión a DTOs se hace en el controlador
     */
    public List<HitlDecisionData> getDecisionHistory(String type, String decision, Integer limit) {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL decision history: type={}, decision={}, limit={}", type, decision, limit);
        try {
            List<HitlDecision> allDecisions = getAllDecisions();

            // Aplicar filtros
            if (type != null) {
                allDecisions = allDecisions.stream()
                    .filter(d -> type.equals(d.getHitlentitytype()))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            if (decision != null) {
                allDecisions = allDecisions.stream()
                    .filter(d -> decision.equals(d.getHitldecision()))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            // Ordenar por fecha descendente y limitar
            List<HitlDecision> sorted = allDecisions.stream()
                .sorted((d1, d2) -> d2.getHitldecisiondate().compareTo(d1.getHitldecisiondate()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

            if (limit != null && limit > 0) {
                sorted = sorted.stream().limit(limit).collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            return sorted.stream()
                .map(this::toDecisionData)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving HITL decision history", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving HITL decision history", e);
        }

    /**
     * Crea una intervención HITL desde un microservicio de negocio
     * Este método es llamado por los microservicios cuando necesitan supervisión humana
     * y dispara un BPMN que espera la decisión humana
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param supervisionType Tipo de supervisión (AGENT_APPROVAL, MODEL_DEPLOYMENT, etc.)
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Agent, Model, Prompt)
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityName Nombre de la entidad
     * @param slaHours SLA en horas (opcional, default 4)
     * @return ID de la intervención creada
     */
    public Long createIntervention(Long projectId, String supervisionType, String entityType,
            Long entityId, String entityName, Integer slaHours) {
        log.info("Creating HITL intervention: projectId={}, type={}, entityType={}, entityId={}",
            projectId, supervisionType, entityType, entityId);

        try {
            // Opcional: Evaluar automáticamente si realmente necesita supervisión humana
            String autoEvaluationResult = performAutoEvaluation(entityType, entityId, entityName);

            HitlSupervision supervision = new HitlSupervision();
            supervision.setIdxproject(projectId);
            supervision.setHitlsupervisiontype(supervisionType);
            supervision.setHitlentitytype(entityType);
            supervision.setIdxentity(entityId);
            supervision.setHitlentityname(entityName);
            supervision.setHitlsla(slaHours != null ? slaHours : 4);
            supervision.setHitlcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            supervision.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

            // Almacenar resultado de evaluación automática en configuración JSONB
            if (autoEvaluationResult != null) {
                supervision.setHitlconfiguration(autoEvaluationResult);
                log.info("Evaluación automática realizada y almacenada para intervención: entityType={}, entityId={}",
                    entityType, entityId);
            }

            supervision = supervisionRepository.save(supervision);
            log.info("HITL intervention created with ID: {}", supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN para la intervención HITL
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerHitlWorkflow(
                supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision(),
                projectId,
                supervisionType,
                entityType,
                entityId,
                entityName,
                slaHours != null ? slaHours : 4
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente para intervención HITL: interventionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision(), workflowInstanceId);
            }

            return supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error creating HITL intervention", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error creating HITL intervention", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene el dashboard completo de HITL con métricas y datos consolidados
     */
    public HitlDashboardData getDashboard(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        try {
            // Obtener supervisiones
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions = projectId != null
                ? getSupervisionsByProject(projectId)
                : getAllSupervisions();

            // Obtener decisiones
            List<HitlDecision> allDecisions = getAllDecisions();

                    .collect(Collectors.toList());

            // Construir respuesta

            dashboard.metrics = metrics;
            dashboard.pendingInterventions = pendingInterventions;
            dashboard.recentDecisions = recentDecisions;
            dashboard.supervisionConfig = supervisionConfig;

            return dashboard;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving HITL dashboard", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving HITL dashboard", e);
        }

    public List<HitlInterventionData> getInterventions(Long projectId, String status, String type) {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL interventions - projectId: {}, status: {}, type: {}",
            projectId, status, type);

        try {
            // Obtener supervisiones
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions = projectId != null
                ? getSupervisionsByProject(projectId)
                : getAllSupervisions();

            // Obtener decisiones
            List<HitlDecision> allDecisions = getAllDecisions();

            // Filtrar por proyecto si es necesario
            if (projectId != null) {
                Set<Long> supervisionIds = supervisions.stream()
                    .map(HitlSupervision::getIdxhitlsupervision)
                    .collect(Collectors.toSet());
                allDecisions = allDecisions.stream()
                    .filter(d -> {
                        Long supervisionId = d.getIdxhitlsupervision();
                        return supervisionId != null && supervisionIds.contains(supervisionId);
                    })
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            // Obtener intervenciones pendientes
            List<HitlInterventionData> interventions = getPendingInterventions(supervisions, allDecisions);

            // Aplicar filtros
            if (status != null && !status.equals("ALL")) {
                interventions = interventions.stream()
                    .filter(i -> i.status.equals(status))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            if (type != null && !type.equals("ALL")) {
                interventions = interventions.stream()
                    .filter(i -> i.entityType.equals(type))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            return interventions;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving HITL interventions", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving HITL interventions", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Registra una decisión humana para una intervención HITL
     */
    public HitlDecisionData recordDecision(HitlDecisionRequestData request) {
        log.info("Recording HITL decision for interventionId: {}", request.interventionId);

        try {
            // Buscar la supervisión relacionada
            Optional<HitlSupervision> supervisionOpt = supervisionRepository.findById(request.interventionId);
            if (supervisionOpt.isEmpty()) {
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Supervision not found: " + request.interventionId);
            }
            HitlSupervision supervision = supervisionOpt.get();

            // Crear nueva decisión
            HitlDecision decision = new HitlDecision();
            // Establecer la relación con la supervisión usando la instancia existente
            decision.setHitlSupervision(supervision);
            // Obtener tipo de entidad y ID de la supervisión
            decision.setHitlentitytype(supervision.getHitlentitytype() != null
                ? supervision.getHitlentitytype()
                : "AGENT");
            decision.setIdxentity(supervision.getIdxentity() != null
                ? supervision.getIdxentity()
                : supervision.getIdxproject());
            decision.setHitldecision(request.decision);
            decision.setHitldecisionreason(request.reason);
            decision.setHitldecisiondate(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            decision.setHitluserid(request.userId != null ? request.userId : "system");

            // Calcular tiempo de respuesta
            long minutes = ChronoUnit.MINUTES.between(
                supervision.getHitlcreatedat().toLocalDateTime(),
                LocalDateTime.now()
            );
            decision.setHitlresponsetime((int) minutes);

            // Generar UUID
            decision.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

            // Guardar decisión
            decision = decisionRepository.save(decision);
            log.info("HITL decision recorded with ID: {}", decision.getIdxhitldecision());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN para notificar la decisión
            triggerHitlDecisionWorkflow(
                supervision.getIdxproject(),
                request.interventionId,
                decision.getIdxhitldecision(),
                supervision.getHitlsupervisiontype(),
                supervision.getHitlentitytype(),
                supervision.getIdxentity(),
                supervision.getHitlentityname(),
                request.decision,
                request.reason,
                request.userId
            );

            // Convertir a DTO
            return toDecisionData(decision);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error recording HITL decision", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error recording HITL decision", e);
        }
    }

    public List<HitlSupervisionConfigData> getSupervisionConfig(Long projectId) {

    /**
     * Actualiza la configuración de supervisión HITL
     * Recibe y retorna clase de datos interna (NO DTO) - la conversión DTO ↔ Clase interna se hace en el controlador
     */
    public HitlSupervisionConfigData updateSupervisionConfig(HitlSupervisionConfigData configData) {
        log.info("Updating HITL supervision config for type: {}", configData.type);

        try {
            // Buscar supervisión por tipo
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions = supervisionRepository.findByType(configData.type);
            HitlSupervision supervision = supervisions.isEmpty() ? null : supervisions.get(0);

            if (supervision == null) {
                // Crear nueva supervisión si no existe
                supervision = new HitlSupervision();
                supervision.setHitlsupervisiontype(configData.type);
                supervision.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());
                supervision.setHitlcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            }

            // Actualizar configuración
            supervision.setHitlsla(configData.slaHours);
            // Nota: enabled, requiredRoles, autoEscalation, escalationHours
            // deberían almacenarse en HITLCONFIGURATION (JSONB)
            // Por simplicidad, asumimos que se actualiza el JSONB
            supervision.setHitlconfiguration(buildConfigurationJson(configData));

            supervision.setHitlupdatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            supervision = supervisionRepository.save(supervision);

            log.info("HITL supervision config updated for type: {}", configData.type);
            return toConfigData(supervision);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error updating HITL supervision config", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error updating HITL supervision config", e);
        }
    }

    // ========== MÉTODOS PRIVADOS ==========

    private List<HitlSupervision> getSupervisionsByProject(Long projectId) {
        return supervisionRepository.findByProjectId(projectId);
    }

    private List<HitlSupervision> getAllSupervisions() {
        List<HitlSupervision> all = supervisionRepository.findAll();
        // Ordenar por fecha de creación descendente
        return all.stream()
            .sorted((s1, s2) -> {
                if (s1.getHitlcreatedat() == null && s2.getHitlcreatedat() == null) return 0;
                if (s1.getHitlcreatedat() == null) return 1;
                if (s2.getHitlcreatedat() == null) return -1;
                return s2.getHitlcreatedat().compareTo(s1.getHitlcreatedat());
            })
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private List<HitlDecision> getAllDecisions() {
        return decisionRepository.findRecentDecisions();
    }

    private HitlMetricsData calculateMetrics(List<HitlDecision> decisions, List<HitlSupervision> supervisions) {
        HitlMetricsData metrics = new HitlMetricsData();

        if (decisions.isEmpty()) {
            metrics.averageResponseTime = 0.0;
            metrics.approvalRate = 0.0;
            metrics.slaCompliance = 0.0;
            metrics.pendingInterventions = 0;
            metrics.totalInterventions = 0;
            metrics.interventionsByType = new HashMap<>();
            metrics.interventionsByStatus = new HashMap<>();
            return metrics;
        }

        // Tiempo promedio de respuesta (en horas)
        double avgResponseTime = decisions.stream()
            .filter(d -> d.getHitlresponsetime() != null)
            .mapToInt(HitlDecision::getHitlresponsetime)
            .average()
            .orElse(0.0) / 60.0; // Convertir minutos a horas

        // Tasa de aprobación
        long approved = decisions.stream()
            .filter(d -> "APPROVED".equals(d.getHitldecision()))
            .count();
        double approvalRate = decisions.size() > 0 ? (double) approved / decisions.size() : 0.0;

        // SLA cumplimiento
        int avgSlaHours = (int) supervisions.stream()
            .filter(s -> s.getHitlsla() != null)
            .mapToInt(HitlSupervision::getHitlsla)
            .average()
            .orElse(4.0); // Default 4 horas

        long slaCompliant = decisions.stream()
            .filter(d -> d.getHitlresponsetime() != null)
            .filter(d -> d.getHitlresponsetime() <= (avgSlaHours * 60))
            .count();
        double slaCompliance = decisions.size() > 0 ? (double) slaCompliant / decisions.size() : 0.0;

        // Intervenciones pendientes
        Set<Long> decidedSupervisionIds = decisions.stream()
            .map(HitlDecision::getIdxhitlsupervision)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());
        long pendingInterventions = supervisions.stream()
            .filter(s -> !decidedSupervisionIds.contains(s.getIdxhitlsupervision()))
            .count();

        // Intervenciones por tipo
        Map<String, Integer> byType = decisions.stream()
            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(
                HitlDecision::getHitlentitytype,
                Collectors.collectingAndThen(Collectors.counting(), Long::intValue)
            ));

        // Intervenciones por estado
        Map<String, Integer> byStatus = decisions.stream()
            .collect(Collectors.groupingBy(
                HitlDecision::getHitldecision,
                Collectors.collectingAndThen(Collectors.counting(), Long::intValue)
            ));

        metrics.averageResponseTime = avgResponseTime;
        metrics.approvalRate = approvalRate;
        metrics.slaCompliance = slaCompliance;
        metrics.pendingInterventions = (int) pendingInterventions;
        metrics.totalInterventions = decisions.size();
        metrics.interventionsByType = byType;
        metrics.interventionsByStatus = byStatus;

        return metrics;
    }

    private List<HitlInterventionData> getPendingInterventions(
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions,
            List<HitlDecision> decisions) {

        Set<Long> decidedSupervisionIds = decisions.stream()
            .map(HitlDecision::getIdxhitlsupervision)
            .collect(Collectors.toSet());

        return supervisions.stream()
            .filter(s -> !decidedSupervisionIds.contains(s.getIdxhitlsupervision()))
            .map(this::toInterventionData)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private List<HitlDecisionData> getRecentDecisions(List<HitlDecision> decisions, int limit) {
        return decisions.stream()
            .sorted((d1, d2) -> d2.getHitldecisiondate().compareTo(d1.getHitldecisiondate()))
            .limit(limit)
            .map(this::toDecisionData)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private List<HitlSupervisionConfigData> getSupervisionConfig(List<HitlSupervision> supervisions) {
        return supervisions.stream()
            .map(this::toConfigData)
            .collect(Collectors.toList());
    }

    private HitlInterventionData toInterventionData(HitlSupervision supervision) {
        HitlInterventionData data = new HitlInterventionData();
        data.id = supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision();
        data.type = supervision.getHitlsupervisiontype();
        data.entityType = supervision.getHitlentitytype() != null
            ? supervision.getHitlentitytype()
            : "AGENT";
        data.entityId = supervision.getIdxentity() != null
            ? supervision.getIdxentity()
            : supervision.getIdxproject();
        data.entityName = supervision.getHitlentityname() != null
            ? supervision.getHitlentityname()
            : ("Entity " + (supervision.getIdxentity() != null ? supervision.getIdxentity() : supervision.getIdxproject()));
        data.status = "PENDING";
        data.createdAt = supervision.getHitlcreatedat().toLocalDateTime();

        // Calcular SLA deadline
        LocalDateTime deadline = supervision.getHitlcreatedat().toLocalDateTime()
            .plusHours(supervision.getHitlsla() != null ? supervision.getHitlsla() : 4);
        data.slaDeadline = deadline;
        data.slaHours = supervision.getHitlsla() != null ? supervision.getHitlsla() : 4;

        // Calcular tiempo restante
        long hoursRemaining = ChronoUnit.HOURS.between(LocalDateTime.now(), deadline);
        data.timeRemaining = (double) hoursRemaining;

        // Determinar urgencia
        if (hoursRemaining < 1) {
            data.urgency = "CRITICAL";
        } else if (hoursRemaining < 2) {
            data.urgency = "HIGH";
        } else if (hoursRemaining < 4) {
            data.urgency = "MEDIUM";
        } else {
            data.urgency = "LOW";
        }

        return data;
    }

    private HitlDecisionData toDecisionData(HitlDecision decision) {
        HitlDecisionData data = new HitlDecisionData();
        data.id = decision.getIdxhitldecision();
        data.type = decision.getHitlentitytype() != null ? decision.getHitlentitytype() : "AGENT";
        data.entityType = decision.getHitlentitytype() != null ? decision.getHitlentitytype() : "AGENT";
        data.entityId = decision.getIdxentity();
        // Obtener nombre de entidad desde la supervisión relacionada si es posible
        data.entityName = decision.getIdxentity() != null
            ? ("Entity " + decision.getIdxentity())
            : "Unknown Entity";
        data.decision = decision.getHitldecision();
        data.decisionReason = decision.getHitldecisionreason();
        data.responseTime = decision.getHitlresponsetime() != null
            ? decision.getHitlresponsetime() / 60.0
            : 0.0;
        data.decisionDate = decision.getHitldecisiondate() != null
            ? decision.getHitldecisiondate().toLocalDateTime()
            : LocalDateTime.now();
        data.userId = decision.getHitluserid() != null ? decision.getHitluserid() : "system";
        return data;
    }

    private HitlSupervisionConfigData toConfigData(HitlSupervision supervision) {
        HitlSupervisionConfigData data = new HitlSupervisionConfigData();
        data.type = supervision.getHitlsupervisiontype();
        data.enabled = true; // Parsear del JSONB
        data.slaHours = supervision.getHitlsla() != null ? supervision.getHitlsla() : 4;
        data.requiredRoles = java.util.Arrays.asList("governance-admin", "compliance-officer");
        data.autoEscalation = true;
        data.escalationHours = 12;
        return data;
    }

    private String determineEntityType(Long interventionId) {
        // Lógica simplificada - en producción debería consultar la relación real
        return "AGENT";
    }

    private String buildConfigurationJson(HitlSupervisionConfigData config) {
        // Construir JSON simple para configuración
        return String.format(
            "{\"enabled\":%s,\"requiredRoles\":%s,\"autoEscalation\":%s,\"escalationHours\":%d}",
            config.enabled,
            config.requiredRoles != null ? config.requiredRoles.toString() : "[]",
            config.autoEscalation,
            config.escalationHours != null ? config.escalationHours : 12
        );
    }

    // ========== NOTA: Los métodos de conversión a DTOs están en el controlador ==========
    // El servicio de negocio NO debe conocer DTOs según la arquitectura

    /**
     * Dispara workflow BPMN para intervención HITL
     *
     * Este método se ejecuta desde el servicio de negocio según la arquitectura del sistema.
     * Usa el cliente BPMN para llamar al microservicio de workflow.
     *
     * @param interventionId ID de la intervención HITL
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param supervisionType Tipo de supervisión (AGENT_APPROVAL, MODEL_DEPLOYMENT, etc.)
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Agent, Model, Prompt)
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityName Nombre de la entidad
     * @param slaHours SLA en horas
     * @return ID de la instancia de workflow creada, o null si falla o no está disponible
     */
    private String triggerHitlWorkflow(Long interventionId, Long projectId, String supervisionType,
            String entityType, Long entityId, String entityName, Integer slaHours) {
        log.info("Disparando workflow BPMN para intervención HITL: interventionId={}, projectId={}, type={}",
                interventionId, projectId, supervisionType);

        // Verificar si el cliente BPMN está disponible
        if (bpmnWorkflowClient == null || !bpmnWorkflowClient.isAvailable()) {
            log.warn("BpmnWorkflowClient no está disponible. Workflow BPMN no se disparará.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            // Preparar variables del workflow
            Map<String, Object> variables = new HashMap<>();
            variables.put("interventionId", interventionId);
            variables.put("projectId", projectId);
            variables.put("supervisionType", supervisionType);
            variables.put("entityType", entityType);
            variables.put("entityId", entityId);
            variables.put("entityName", entityName);
            variables.put("slaHours", slaHours);
            variables.put("createdAt", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN usando el cliente
            String workflowInstanceId = bpmnWorkflowClient.startProcess(
                    "hitl-supervision-process",
                    variables
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente: interventionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                        interventionId, workflowInstanceId);
            }

            return workflowInstanceId;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error disparando workflow BPMN para intervención HITL: interventionId={}", interventionId, e);
            // No lanzar excepción para no fallar la operación si el workflow falla
            return null;
        }
    }

    /**
     * Realiza evaluación automática usando microservicios de Python para determinar
     * si realmente se necesita supervisión humana.
     *
     * Este método es opcional y solo se ejecuta si AIGovernanceClient está disponible.
     * Proporciona contexto adicional al supervisor humano.
     *
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Agent, Model, Prompt)
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityName Nombre de la entidad
     * @return Resultado de evaluación automática en formato JSON, o null si no está disponible
     */
    private String performAutoEvaluation(String entityType, Long entityId, String entityName) {
        if (aiGovernanceClient == null) {
            log.debug("AIGovernanceClient no disponible. Evaluación automática omitida.");
            return null;
        }

        try {
            Map<String, Object> evaluationResult = new HashMap<>();
            evaluationResult.put("entityType", entityType);
            evaluationResult.put("entityId", entityId);
            evaluationResult.put("entityName", entityName);
            evaluationResult.put("evaluatedAt", LocalDateTime.now().toString());

            // Evaluar según el tipo de entidad
            switch (entityType.toUpperCase()) {
                case "PROMPT":
                    // Evaluar seguridad del prompt
                    try {
                        // TODO: Obtener el contenido del prompt desde la entidad
                        // Por ahora, solo registramos que se evaluaría
                        log.info("Evaluación automática de prompt: entityId={}", entityId);
                        evaluationResult.put("promptEvaluation", "PENDING");
                        evaluationResult.put("note", "Prompt evaluation requires prompt content");
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        log.warn("Error en evaluación automática de prompt", e);
                    }
                    break;

                case "MODEL":
                    // Evaluar modelo (alucinaciones, calidad, etc.)
                    try {
                        log.info("Evaluación automática de modelo: entityId={}", entityId);
                        evaluationResult.put("modelEvaluation", "PENDING");
                        evaluationResult.put("note", "Model evaluation requires model details");
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        log.warn("Error en evaluación automática de modelo", e);
                    }
                    break;

                case "AGENT":
                    // Monitorear agente (loops, costos, ejecución)
                    try {
                        log.info("Evaluación automática de agente: entityId={}", entityId);
                        evaluationResult.put("agentEvaluation", "PENDING");
                        evaluationResult.put("note", "Agent evaluation requires agent execution data");
                    } catch (Exception e) {
                        log.warn("Error en evaluación automática de agente", e);
                    }
                    break;

                default:
                    log.debug("Tipo de entidad no soportado para evaluación automática: {}", entityType);
                    return null;
            }

            // Serializar resultado a JSON
            try {
                // Usar ObjectMapper si está disponible, sino construir JSON manualmente
                try {
                    com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper objectMapper =
                        new com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper();
                    return objectMapper.writeValueAsString(evaluationResult);
                } catch (NoClassDefFoundError e) {
                    // Si ObjectMapper no está disponible, construir JSON manualmente
                    StringBuilder json = new StringBuilder("{");
                    json.append("\"entityType\":\"").append(entityType).append("\",");
                    json.append("\"entityId\":").append(entityId).append(",");
                    json.append("\"entityName\":\"").append(entityName != null ? entityName.replace("\"", "\\\"") : "").append("\",");
                    json.append("\"evaluatedAt\":\"").append(LocalDateTime.now().toString()).append("\"");
                    json.append("}");
                    return json.toString();
                }
            } catch (Exception e) {
                log.warn("Error serializando resultado de evaluación automática", e);
                return null;
            }

        } catch (ServiceUnavailableException e) {
            log.warn("Microservicio de Python no disponible para evaluación automática", e);
            return null;
        } catch (AIGovernanceException e) {
            log.warn("Error en microservicio de Python para evaluación automática: service={}, status={}",
                e.getService(), e.getStatusCode(), e);
            return null;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.warn("Error inesperado en evaluación automática", e);
            return null;
        }
    }

    // ========== CLASES DE DATOS INTERNAS ==========

    public static class HitlDashboardData {
        public HitlMetricsData metrics;
        public List<HitlInterventionData> pendingInterventions;

    }
}
```

Añadiendo el método para disparar el workflow BPMN cuando se registra una decisión:


```java
package com.codeflowx.govern.business.compliance;

import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;

import lombok.extern.slf4j.Slf4j;

import com.codeflowx.govern.business.client.BpmnWorkflowClient;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.AIGovernanceClient;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.exception.ServiceUnavailableException;
import com.codeflowx.governance.client.exception.AIGovernanceException;
import java.sql.Timestamp;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.UUID;

import java.util.stream.Collectors;

import java.util.Map;

import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;

/**
 * BusinessService para HITL Supervision según Art. 14 EU AI Act
 *
 * Gestiona supervisión humana (Human In The Loop) para sistemas de IA.
 * Ubicación: codeflowx.govern.business/src/main/java/com/codeflowx/govern/business/compliance/
 */
@Service
@Slf4j
public class HitlSupervisionBusinessService {

    @Autowired
    private HitlSupervisionRepository supervisionRepository;

    @Autowired
    private HitlDecisionRepository decisionRepository;

    private BpmnWorkflowClient bpmnWorkflowClient;

    private AIGovernanceClient aiGovernanceClient;

    /**

     */
    public HitlDashboardData getDashboardMetrics() {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL dashboard metrics");
        return getDashboard(null);
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene intervenciones pendientes con filtros
     * Retorna clases de datos internas (NO DTOs) - la conversión a DTOs se hace en el controlador
     */
    public List<HitlInterventionData> getPendingInterventions(String type, String entityType, Boolean slaExceeded) {
        log.info("Retrieving pending HITL interventions: type={}, entityType={}, slaExceeded={}",
            type, entityType, slaExceeded);
        try {
            List<HitlInterventionData> interventions = getInterventions(null, "PENDING", type);

            // Aplicar filtros adicionales
            if (entityType != null) {
                interventions = interventions.stream()
                    .filter(i -> entityType.equals(i.entityType))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            if (slaExceeded != null && slaExceeded) {
                interventions = interventions.stream()
                    .filter(i -> i.timeRemaining != null && i.timeRemaining <= 0)
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            return interventions;
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving pending HITL interventions", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving pending HITL interventions", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Registra una decisión humana
     * Retorna clase de datos interna (NO DTO) - la conversión a DTO se hace en el controlador
     */
    public HitlDecisionData recordDecision(Long interventionId, String decision, String reason, String userId) {
        log.info("Recording HITL decision: interventionId={}, decision={}", interventionId, decision);
        try {
            HitlDecisionRequestData request = new HitlDecisionRequestData();
            request.interventionId = interventionId;
            request.decision = decision;
            request.reason = reason;
            request.userId = userId;

            return recordDecision(request);

    /**
     * Obtiene historial de decisiones
     * Retorna clases de datos internas (NO DTOs) - la conversión a DTOs se hace en el controlador
     */
    public List<HitlDecisionData> getDecisionHistory(String type, String decision, Integer limit) {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL decision history: type={}, decision={}, limit={}", type, decision, limit);
        try {
            List<HitlDecision> allDecisions = getAllDecisions();

            // Aplicar filtros
            if (type != null) {
                allDecisions = allDecisions.stream()
                    .filter(d -> type.equals(d.getHitlentitytype()))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            if (decision != null) {
                allDecisions = allDecisions.stream()
                    .filter(d -> decision.equals(d.getHitldecision()))
                    .collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            // Ordenar por fecha descendente y limitar
            List<HitlDecision> sorted = allDecisions.stream()
                .sorted((d1, d2) -> d2.getHitldecisiondate().compareTo(d1.getHitldecisiondate()))
                .collect(Collectors.toList());

            if (limit != null && limit > 0) {
                sorted = sorted.stream().limit(limit).collect(Collectors.toList());
            }

            return sorted.stream()
                .map(this::toDecisionData)
                .collect(Collectors.toList());
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving HITL decision history", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving HITL decision history", e);
        }
    }

    /**

     * Retorna clases de datos internas (NO DTOs) - la conversión a DTOs se hace en el controlador
     */
    public List<HitlSupervisionConfigData> getSupervisionConfig() {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL supervision configuration");
        try {
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions = getAllSupervisions();
            return getSupervisionConfig(supervisions);
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error retrieving HITL supervision configuration", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error retrieving HITL supervision configuration", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Crea una intervención HITL desde un microservicio de negocio
     * Este método es llamado por los microservicios cuando necesitan supervisión humana
     * y dispara un BPMN que espera la decisión humana
     *
     * @param projectId ID del proyecto
     * @param supervisionType Tipo de supervisión (AGENT_APPROVAL, MODEL_DEPLOYMENT, etc.)
     * @param entityType Tipo de entidad (Agent, Model, Prompt)
     * @param entityId ID de la entidad
     * @param entityName Nombre de la entidad
     * @param slaHours SLA en horas (opcional, default 4)
     * @return ID de la intervención creada
     */
    public Long createIntervention(Long projectId, String supervisionType, String entityType,
            Long entityId, String entityName, Integer slaHours) {
        log.info("Creating HITL intervention: projectId={}, type={}, entityType={}, entityId={}",
            projectId, supervisionType, entityType, entityId);

        try {
            // Opcional: Evaluar automáticamente si realmente necesita supervisión humana
            String autoEvaluationResult = performAutoEvaluation(entityType, entityId, entityName);

            HitlSupervision supervision = new HitlSupervision();
            supervision.setIdxproject(projectId);
            supervision.setHitlsupervisiontype(supervisionType);
            supervision.setHitlentitytype(entityType);
            supervision.setIdxentity(entityId);
            supervision.setHitlentityname(entityName);
            supervision.setHitlsla(slaHours != null ? slaHours : 4);
            supervision.setHitlcreatedat(new Timestamp(System.currentTimeMillis()));
            supervision.setIduuid(UUID.randomUUID().toString());

            // Almacenar resultado de evaluación automática en configuración JSONB
            if (autoEvaluationResult != null) {
                supervision.setHitlconfiguration(autoEvaluationResult);
                log.info("Evaluación automática realizada y almacenada para intervención: entityType={}, entityId={}",
                    entityType, entityId);
            }

            supervision = supervisionRepository.save(supervision);
            log.info("HITL intervention created with ID: {}", supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision());

            // Disparar workflow BPMN para la intervención HITL
            String workflowInstanceId = triggerHitlWorkflow(
                supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision(),
                projectId,
                supervisionType,
                entityType,
                entityId,
                entityName,
                slaHours != null ? slaHours : 4
            );

            if (workflowInstanceId != null) {
                log.info("Workflow BPMN disparado exitosamente para intervención HITL: interventionId={}, workflowInstanceId={}",
                    supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision(), workflowInstanceId);
            }

            return supervision.getIdxhitlsupervision();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            log.error("Error creating HITL intervention", e);
            throw new RuntimeException("Error creating HITL intervention", e);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Obtiene el dashboard completo de HITL con métricas y datos consolidados
     */
    public HitlDashboardData getDashboard(Long projectId) {
        log.info("Retrieving HITL dashboard for projectId: {}", projectId);

        try {
            // Obtener supervisiones
            List<HitlSupervision> supervisions = projectId != null
                ? getSupervisionsByProject(projectId)
                : getAllSupervisions();

            // Obtener decisiones
            List<HitlDecision> allDecisions = getAllDecisions();

                // Filtrar decisiones por proyecto (a través de supervisiones)
                Set<Long> supervisionIds = supervisions.stream()
```
